A LITTLE GUIDANCE

Every detail, a little more yours.

Edit words already in a PDF

Open a document and choose Edit existing text. Click a highlighted text area to replace it, then use the panel to change its wording, font, size, or color. Font matching is approximate; choose a font and background color that suit the original.

Work with a card, photo, or scan

Open a JPG, PNG, or WebP. Detect text in scan uses English OCR to find editable text regions on the current page. Or use Cover area to cover old content and add your own text or image. Photos in the original background are not separate editable objects.

Arrange everything visually

Select an element to drag it. Corner handles resize it; the top handle rotates it. The inspector provides exact positions and layer ordering. Undo and redo are available for each page. Arrow keys nudge a selected element; Shift + arrow moves it farther.

Export your finished document

Export all pages as a PDF, or the current page as a PNG/JPG. PDF pages are flattened into images, including replacement text and covered regions. This removes selectable text, form fields, links, and existing digital signatures. Keep your original when you need those features. Original fonts and complex backgrounds may not match perfectly.

Documents stay in browser memory. OCR downloads its recognition engine and English model on first use. Your browser and device capacity determine practical document sizes.
ALL WRAPPED UP

Make it official.

Exports are flattened. The result includes visible edits and covers, with no editable layers or underlying original text. Existing forms, links, and digital signatures are removed.
